name: Vehicle Summon
description: The whistle. Open worlds are big, and walking back to where you parked is not content; this component owns the summon verb — validate the target point's terrain, respect cooldown and zone rules, and materialise the ride at the nearest legal spot. Everything after materialisation belongs to movement.vehicle_basic, which owns physics, boarding, and the drive itself; the summon deliberately ends at 'the vehicle exists next to you'. It does not own multi-vehicle storage or upgrades — that is a garage system's job, out of scope for this pack — and it never summons into combat, because an armoured mount on demand is an escape button with horsepower.

inputs.name: summonCooldownSeconds
inputs.description: Minimum gap between summons. Long enough that dismissing to dodge a fall and re-summoning is not a strategy.

inputs.name: maxSummonDistance
inputs.description: How far away the vehicle may materialise. Close enough to read as 'it came to you', far enough to not clip through the player.

inputs.name: allowedTerrains
inputs.description: Terrain tags where materialisation is legal. Water is excluded by omission — a horse arriving mid-lake is a support ticket, not a feature.

inputs.name: dismissRefundCooldown
inputs.description: Whether a voluntary dismiss refunds the cooldown. True encourages parking etiquette; false punishes it, which is backwards.

outputs.name: summonedVehicleId
outputs.description: The live vehicle entity, null when unsummoned.
